headline: HOU @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.95 at DET 3.66, with a projected total of 7.61. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved -0.26 runs while DET moved -0.58, changing the projected margin by +0.32 runs. The projected total fell -0.84, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +13.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Hunter Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 4 outings. Batter research is strongest for Isaac Paredes, Kevin McGonigle, Jeremy Peña, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brice Matthews, James Outman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
